ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_softplus_diff_ratio_delta_regret_clamp_sum
ir.intuition: Shift from pairwise log-ratio and margin losses to a normalized ratio difference penalized by delta_regret with softplus link, clamped for numerical stability and summed for aggregation, encouraging stronger focus on pairs with high regret differences.
ir.pseudocode:
delta = delta_regret.detach() + epsilon
ratio_diff = (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) / delta
x = clamp(ratio_diff, -10, 10)
loss = softplus(-x) * weight
final_loss = sum(loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    delta_regret = batch['delta_regret']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    epsilon = 1e-6
    delta = ops.add(delta_regret.detach(), epsilon)
    ratio_diff = ops.div(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), delta)
    x = ops.clamp(ratio_diff, -10.0, 10.0)
    loss = ops.softplus(ops.neg(x))
    if weight is not None:
        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    return ops.sum(loss)
